about: jorah-guard v0 tool classes (docs/plan/p5-plan.md 4.2). A tool in no class is blocked. Edit only by commit and Adam's yes.
viewReadAbout: Review fix 6 (2026-11-22): the call's own view argument decides, before the tool runs (lib/policy.js cleanView). No arguments, or exactly {"view": "installed"}, is a read: the plugin then returns only installed tools' names, versions, kinds, command names, pass/fail and counts, each checked against the toolbox's strict shapes, never text a run, a tool or a page wrote. Any other argument or value (view: full shows proposals, notes, smoke output, errors and root commands) is a taintRead. A result-dependent mark is not used, because after_tool_call is observation only; it is kept only as a backstop that adds a mark when a clean-view result isn't the clean view (index.js).

proactive.about: Runs Adam didn't start (docs/runbooks/proactive.md): message is blocked there; they speak only through sendTool.

projects.about: jorah-projects (docs/plan/11-project-mode.md section 5). project_pause is in read on purpose: pausing is always free, even frozen. project_status returns only counts, ids and times, so it stays a read; project_digest carries run-written text, so it marks the chat. project_start (section 5.1) is free in Adam's clean typed chat and a card with his exact words after outside text or by voice; project_connect, project_set_level (level 1 is a schedule) and project_set_capabilities (web research and the robotics bench, issue #14) are always a card. project_preview copies run-rendered images into the workspace outbox for a reply, so it marks the chat like project_digest. Toolbox (docs/runbooks/toolbox.md): toolbox_list is in viewRead: its default view (installed tools, names and versions, counts) is a read, and view full (tool output and run-written proposals) marks the chat; toolbox_propose only writes an inert proposal (the plugin refuses it while frozen), so it is a read; toolbox_install and toolbox_remove are always a card with the exact fields (id, name, version, source, sha256, licence, released, size), and only they write the installer's queue.

errands.about: jorah-errands (docs/runbooks/errands.md). reminder_job and price_compare only compute: they return an automations call or numbers and set nothing, so they are reads; the reminder itself still goes through automations and the schedule rule. supply_list and supply_plan read Adam's own record, which only supply_save writes, so they are reads too. supply_save is free in Adam's clean typed chat and a card with the exact fields after outside text or by voice; supply_forget deletes, so it is always a card.

pictures.about: picture_save (jorah-projects, 2026-11-23, Adam's call: Jorah keeps pictures by the AGENTS.md rules, without a card). It only copies pictures Adam sent (an attachment recorded in the same chat, or a file inside the inbound-media folders, lib/media.js) into <workspace>/files/pictures/ under a new dated name, appends a line to INDEX.md there, never overwrites, and refuses while frozen; it reads no outside text and sends nothing. The worst a hijacked call can do is keep one of Adam's own pictures in his own private folder, so it is a read, like toolbox_propose.

urlSourcesAbout: Tools whose results may add seen URLs: outside readers only, the tools OpenClaw 2026.10.9 itself marks resultContentSource network (canvas, crabbox and decision_evaluate are not Jorah's). Even from these, a URL contained in the model's own arguments, or in anything it wrote after outside text, is not seen (lib/policy.js resultSeeds). Not here on purpose: read, write, edit, memory and sessions tools, exec, site_read (its reader is a model that takes Jorah's question), mail and calendar (a GitHub notification can carry text Jorah wrote). Adding one needs Adam's yes.
urlSeenMaxCharsAbout: Issue #15: a link an outside reader returned, which the model didn't write (lib/policy.js resultSeeds), may be up to this long after outside text; search-result shop links carry query parameters. Credential-like parameters and token shapes are refused at any length. Links nobody gave keep urlMaxChars.
consultToolsAbout: 2026-11-22: a consult agent may call only these, whatever their class. On the Max lane deep runs outside the sandbox (claude-cli can't honour it), so the sandbox's tool list no longer narrows it: without this, reads such as memory_get, supply_list or read would reach Adam's data. on the Max lane, agents.entries.deep.tools.allow says the same (config/pc/max-lane.patch.json5). Adding one needs Adam's yes.
consultBrowserAbout: Issue #15: a consult agent's browser only reads, in Jorah's own headless profile in its sandbox: no act (click, type, select), emulate, requests, other profiles, host or node targets, or dashboards. Its finds go up to the chat that asked it, after link hygiene (index.js).
consultAgentsAbout: Agents main asks for a second opinion, never with a card (Adam's yes of 2026-11-21). In their own sessions only read, search and url tools are allowed: no shell, no writes, no sessions tools, no spawns. Their fetches follow the URL rule like any chat that isn't Adam's own. Adding one needs Adam's yes and the same tool limits in its config (config/pc/deep-consult.patch.json5).
